column3: ../trade-query/data/grammar.json. One row per C++ filter and per trade filter that reads an item; trade's status_filters and trade_filters groups are excluded (they read a listing
column4: not an item). `condition` is the inversion of conditions.csv; `kind` is hand-kept.

column6: note
Location is not an item property; the filter language runs at drop time.
BaseType matches a base-type name; the C++ Name filter is a case-insensitive substring over name+typeLine together, so it also matches unique names, which no condition does.
Class names an item class; the C++ Category substring-matches RePoE class display names. Different vocabularies for the same axis.
Rarity is ORDERED in the filter language (Rarity > Magic); the C++ combo is an unordered choice.
